trap.label: generalização
trap.wrong: All teenagers are addicted to phones.
trap.right: Many teenagers seem to be addicted to phones.
trap.why: Em português “todos” e “sempre” são comuns na fala. Em prosa acadêmica em inglês, evite absolutos: use many, tend to, may, seem.

mcq.q: Which sentence is the most tentative about causes?
opts: It may be caused by stress.

fix.wrong: The results prove that sleep helps.
fix.right: The results suggest that sleep helps.

fix.wrong: It is clearly possibly caused by noise.
fix.right: It is possibly caused by noise.

rewrite.answer: It may be caused by stress.
